metrics.investment_case_interpretation: CAPITAL VC is an investment company. After applying haircuts to cash, listed securities, amortised-cost bond investments and disposal receivables, discounted detachable net financial assets still exceed the rough market capitalisation, but the profit denominator is not a normal operating business cash flow. The case belongs in liquidation_watch, not profit_cheap.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Demand deposits of a Hong Kong listed/Cayman group, but still retained below 1.00 because the entity is an investment company and bank location/restriction split is not further disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash is potentially available before operating cash reserve deductions.

cash_breakdown.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - listed equities
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Listed equities are saleable in principle, but holdings are concentrated in small Hong Kong/GEM/NASDAQ names with large unrealised gains; HK$82.4m was pledged for margin financing.
cash_breakdown.reason: Investment portfolio can be liquidated by a controller, but liquidity and price impact are material.

cash_breakdown.item: Investments in financial assets at amortised cost - current
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Current bond/financial assets mature within one year but include issuer credit risk, ECL allowances and limited early-redemption rights.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potential cash recovery asset, not ordinary operating cash.

cash_breakdown.item: Investments in financial assets at amortised cost - non-current
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Longer-dated unlisted bond/financial assets with ECL history and no active market; default table for non-listed/long-term investment assets supports a low factor.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potential cash recovery asset, but not quickly detachable at book value.

cash_breakdown.item: Consideration receivables on disposal of investments - net
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Receivable has ECL allowance history and depends on counterparty collection; included only at a conservative liquidation value.
cash_breakdown.reason: Investment disposal receivable may convert into cash but collection risk remains.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing borrowings are deducted at 100%; margin financing is secured by FVTPL assets and repayable on demand.
cash_breakdown.reason: Financing debt must be repaid or netted against pledged securities.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserved for roughly one year of administrative expenses and basic listed-company running costs.
cash_breakdown.reason: Removing all cash would impair continued operation and compliance.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, transaction, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Additional reserve for liquidation trading costs, settlement frictions and distribution leakage not separately quantified in the annual report.
cash_breakdown.reason: Needed because the asset pool is securities and private/credit instruments rather than cash.

profit_quality.assessment: No ordinary operating-business earnback denominator was established. Reported 2025 profit was dominated by HK$125.3m net FVTPL gains, including HK$84.6m unrealised gains, and HK$20.6m bond interest income. These profits arise from the same investment assets treated as detachable/liquidation assets above, so counting them as sustainable cash profit would double-count principal and returns.
adjustments: Excluded HK$125.3m net FVTPL gain from sustainable cash profit because it is investment portfolio revaluation/realisation, not recurring operating cash flow after removing the investment assets.
Excluded HK$20.6m bond interest income because the amortised-cost bond assets are included in the detachable asset pool.
Recent three-year attributable profit is highly volatile: HK$131.1m in 2025, -HK$19.9m in 2024 and -HK$149.1m in 2023.
Operating cash flow was HK$22.2m in 2025, -HK$10.7m in 2024 and -HK$19.3m in 2023; this reflects securities and bond cash movements, not a separable ordinary business.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Weak as a normal operating denominator; cash flow is driven by investment asset sales, bond collections, security purchases/sales and interest receipts.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Investment holding structure makes the ordinary-company profit denominator not meaningful once investment assets are deducted as liquidation assets.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Not applicable to ordinary operating-company cash conversion.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Plant and equipment depreciation was HK$172,488; physical capex needs are immaterial.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Working capital movements mainly represent financial assets and investment receivables, not customer receivables/inventory of a normal operating business.

limitations: Input requested period is 2025-12-31, while the latest annual report found is for the year ended 2025-09-30.
Market capitalisation is reused from rough_screen_row and was not independently refreshed.
No share-by-share liquidity analysis was performed for the listed securities portfolio; haircut is a conservative portfolio-level estimate.
Amortised-cost bond recovery depends on issuer credit and settlement; annual report gives ECL but not full collateral/recovery schedules.
No ordinary operating-business earnback denominator is calculated because the company is an investment company.
